caption:
Big bursts of worship feel great. Small daily ones last.

The deeds loved most by Allah are the regular ones, even if few (Sahih al-Bukhari 6465).

Pick one this week:
→ two rak'ah of sunnah you can keep every day
→ one page of Qur'an after Fajr
→ a daily sadaqah, even a small one

Save this and pick your deed today.

📖 Sources
• Sahih al-Bukhari 6465 (Sahih, tr. Muhsin Khan) — sunnah.com/bukhari:6465
Full text: Narrated `Aisha: The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked, "What deeds are loved most by Allah?" He said, "The most regular constant deeds even though they may be few." He added, 'Don't take upon yourselves, except the deeds which are within your ability
• Recitation: Qur'an 99:7 — Mohamed Siddiq Al-Minshawi (Murattal) (EveryAyah.com) — quran.com/99/7
